title: ThousandWorlds: A benchmark for emulating the climates of potentially habitable exoplanets

split.decision: Paper standard evaluation retained. Validation: 20% of unique planet_id groups from paper training, fixed seed 20261030, shared planet assignment across all three subsets. Baseline fits remaining training rows only; published hyperparameters retained. Original row ids, sorted materialized files. New train/val counts: multi-partial 1220/307, multi-complete 1149/294, single-complete 164/39.

allowed_changes: climate emulator architecture, kernels, internal representations, training surrogate losses and optimizers
derived input/output representations preserving the same physical-unit grid predictions
fixed_contract: Emulate the supplied climate simulator outputs from the fixed planetary parameters and simulator category, minimizing the original constrained relative climate-grid RMSE.
existing climate simulations, planetary parameter meanings, simulator categories, planet-group splits and physical field grids/masks
three subset definitions, frozen training-mean normalizers, latitude/variable aggregation, two accuracy guards and five independent fitted predictors
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Row IDs only label output rows; no model or preprocessing may use them as an input (patch audit).
The released GPLFR options `variable_weights` and `output_coregionalization` stay at their baseline values in `code/configs/` (patch audit).
Each prediction slot comes from one fit; averaging fits that differ only by seed inside a slot counts as averaging predictors (patch audit).
replacing the scientific simulator outputs or field meanings with easier climate targets
changing masks, subsets, normalizers, planet grouping or averaging predictors before the five-fit score
